explication: Nature Skills is a reusable research-skill library for AI agents. The principal workflow is: a scholar gives an agent a research task, the agent selects a skill, the skill gathers or transforms source material, and produces a verifiable research artifact. The repository spans discovery, access, reading, writing, review, figures, presentations, and patent conversion. Sampled code confirms multi-source academic search, configurable literature access, and an image-to-editable-PPT pipeline; several other capabilities are represented only by their documented skill directories.
